name: Notible Tables
description: Simple spreadsheets inside Notible: a grid you can sort, filter, format and fill quickly, kept as an ordinary item you can link from any note.
author: Notible
guide:
Create one from the **+** menu → **Data table**, or link it into a note with `[[Table name]]`.

## Working in it

- `Tab` moves right, `Enter` goes to the next row; `Enter` on the last row adds one.
- Drag across cells to copy, paste, clear or format them together. `Ctrl+D` / `Ctrl+R` fill down or right.
- Right-click a column header to sort, format or filter it. Export to CSV from the table's menu.
